steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓How do you convert seconds to milliseconds?


Solution: 

The value in the right parameter of the (0 x 0) operators should be changed from 10 to 1000.
steps.instructions:
When the Player sprite overlaps an umbrella sprite, the countdown runs for 5 seconds, but the umbrella sprite and Player sprite effects disappear faster than that.


Fix the bugs in the code so that the umbrella sprite and Player sprite effects last for the same amount of time as the countdown.

Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player sprite has certain protections against the Enemy sprite after different overlap events.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ Should the Player sprite act as invincible or not invincible after overlapping the umbrella? 

❓Does <true> or <false> show this?

The [set [invincible] to] block should be changed to <true> in the [on (Player) overlaps (Food)] container.
steps.instructions:
When the Player sprite overlaps a raindrop, it loses a life even if the powerUp timer has started. 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player sprite is invincible from the raindrops for 5 seconds after it overlaps an umbrella.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Green Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about Booleans and logic operators. Booleans can be useful to check if specific and/or multiple conditions have been met in a project. They can also be useful in 2D platformer projects to keep track of certain game conditions and to make something happen on certain tilemap events. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: It All Keeps Adding Up
badges.description: Use logic and math to make different things happen in a project.

badges.title: All or Nothing
badges.description: Check if two conditions are both true in a conditional statement.

badges.title: Fork in the Road
badges.description: Check if one of two conditions is true in a conditional statement.

badges.title: Nuh-Uh!
badges.description: Check for the negative, or opposite, of a variable’s current value.

badges.title: Yes/No Question
badges.description: Set a condition using the Boolean values true or false.

badges.title: Knowing Your Surroundings
badges.description: Check for the tile next to a sprite before making something happen in a project.

badges.title: Splat!
badges.description: Set a sprite to be destroyed whenever it touches a tilemap wall.

badges.description: Perform a mathematical operation in a project’s code.
